video_title: Hornets vs Bucks: Coach Charles Lee Postgame Media Availability | 10/11/2026

quotes.speaker: Charles Lee
quotes.summary_phrase: Charles Lee on Charlotte's improved defensive intensity and connectivity
quotes.excerpt: I thought that our defensive intensity and connectivity just went to another level.
quotes.quote: I thought that our defensive intensity and connectivity just went to another level. I really thought our guys tightened the screws. I thought there was a ton of really good possessions defensively where you see a guy either doing a great job on the ball or he gets beat and the shift activity around it, the pick and roll coverage. I just thought that we were covering for each other a ton and so to go from a 26-point first quarter, which is pretty good, to then all of a sudden a 19-point second quarter was really proud of just the defensive connectivity tonight.
quotes.social_post: Charles Lee praised the Hornets defensive connectivity after holding the Bucks to 19 points in the second quarter. He noted the team really tightened the screws and was covering for each other a ton throughout the night.

quotes.speaker: Charles Lee
quotes.summary_phrase: Charles Lee on Brandon Miller's development as an elite two-way player
quotes.excerpt: I want to see him just continue to be like an elite two-way player.
quotes.quote: I want to see him just continue to be like an elite two-way player and do it consistently every night. He is capable of doing so much for our team and impacting the game in so many ways that I would never put a ceiling on what he is able to accomplish for us. So we want to keep pushing the envelope with Brandon. Brandon wants us to keep pushing him. He wants to guard the best player. He wants to continue to be in an offensive action so that he can be a playmaker. It was really good to see him out there today and I thought that he did a heck of a job of impacting the game on both ends.
quotes.social_post: Charles Lee says he will not put a ceiling on Brandon Miller. The coach wants to see Miller continue to develop as an elite two way player who wants to guard the best player and be a playmaker for the team.

quotes.speaker: Charles Lee
quotes.summary_phrase: Charles Lee on Naz Reid's versatility and offensive impact
quotes.excerpt: We want to be able to leverage the versatility that he has.
quotes.quote: Watching him from afar, I think that he hasn't been in a ton of those positions. He definitely has shown throughout his career that he is a very capable scorer and a ton of it I think has been done playing off of other guys and spacing the floor and shooting. But as you continue to dive into the film, there were some areas in which Minnesota did a good job of using him as a screener at times. We want to be able to leverage the versatility that he has and then we also want to be able to push him to another level with some of that maybe mid-post, post-up, versus advantage disadvantages. I think that he has done a really good job so far of just playing under control, letting the spacing around him work and then either figuring it out for himself or his teammates.
quotes.social_post: Coach Charles Lee plans to leverage Naz Reid's versatility by pushing him to take on more mid post and post up opportunities. Lee says Reid has done a good job playing under control and letting the spacing work.

quotes.speaker: Charles Lee
quotes.summary_phrase: Charles Lee on LaMelo Ball's accountability and playmaking improvement
quotes.excerpt: Anytime you challenge Leo, he is going to respond.
quotes.quote: Anytime you challenge Leo, he is going to respond. That is what is so impressive about him. It is impressive about our group, it becomes contagious. He took, like you said, accountability for how he played. He knew he wanted to get better in a lot of different areas and I thought the turnover thing was one of them, but then also I thought again his defensive impact and just no matter making shots, missing shots, you have so much more to give to the game and I thought that he just stayed consistently confident tonight and engaged with whatever was asked of him.
quotes.social_post: Charles Lee says LaMelo Ball is responding well to challenges. Lee noted that Ball took accountability for his play and stayed consistently confident and engaged with his defensive impact regardless of his shooting performance.
